programs.description: Jaideep and his family worship Goddess Tulja Bhavani. Taking advantage of their humility and innocence, Jaideep's friend, Kishore, dupes them and leaves them reliant on the Goddess' help.
Neela, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with Amol, who hails from a middle-class background. Trouble ensues when Vicky, an affluent young man, is attracted to Neela.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.

Maalinga becomes a victim of MLA Jagannath Kaalam's exploitation but seeks justice. After the MLA's contact with influential personalities makes her life even more difficult, she decides to fight back.

Yuvraj works for a renowned politician, Prabhakar, but he falls in love with his daughter, Rani. However, a brewing political conspiracy changes the course of their lives.
Tired of everyday monotony, three women decide to take a break from their married lives and travel together to a coastal city. But, things take a turn when one unexpected incident foils their trip.
Mati, a college student, brought up in a conservative family, plans a solo trip to Goa. Once there, she befriends Maggie and Rumi and ends up learning a few important life lessons.

Sanika and Sayli, twin sisters, suffer from progressive visual impairment. Things turn when the latter decides to take her own life.
While replicating the murals of Ajanta Caves in the eighteenth century, Robert Gill, a skilled painter and a British soldier, falls in love with an Indian tribal girl.
Two affluent business partners place an unusual bet on human tendencies. They use one of their employees and a poor and lazy man in an experiment where they exchange their positions in society.
At Dr Parchure's farmhouse party, a power cut leads to an unexpected situation. The curious guests eagerly investigate the mystery, turning a festive evening into a thrilling hunt for truth.
In a religious fair, two individuals from the villages Hyalagaad and Tyalagaad run a race and even kill for winning the hosting rights of the fair.
Each year, the Kirtikars leave their mansion to go on a three-month vacation to London. Unbeknownst to all, Gopinath, a kind-hearted man who loves to help others, sneaks into the house every time.
A group of women encounter epic adventures when they take a trip together to London to celebrate Indumati's 75th birthday.
Arjun regrets marrying his best friend Mary and blames God for his unhappy life. So, the latter offers him a second chance to rewrite his destiny.
